name: Bupropion
effects: Reduces depressive symptoms; used for smoking cessation (Zyban) and seasonal affective disorder
Activating — improves energy and motivation; may worsen anxiety
Dose-dependent seizure risk — contraindicated in eating disorders, seizure history; never exceed 450 mg/day; no single dose >150 mg (IR) or >200 mg (SR)
No significant serotonergic activity — low serotonin syndrome risk
